candidates.name: Sage Quilted Jacket
candidates.decisionReason: The hanging product image supplies no shoulder, torso or hem proof, while the shiny horizontal quilting risks generic packable outerwear rather than a refined travel layer.

candidates.name: White Quilted Snap Puffer
candidates.decisionReason: Full-resolution review exposes a prominent ADVANCED chest wordmark, a long bulky body and low dropped shoulder; the light color does not justify the visible branding and excess volume.

candidates.name: Dusty-Blue Quilted Puffer
candidates.decisionReason: Full-resolution body proof shows a clean regular-length puffer with controlled shoulder and sleeve volume; dusty blue adds Winter color without a dark, logo-heavy or oversized silhouette.

candidates.name: Light-Green Puffer
candidates.decisionReason: The product-only image lacks fit proof, while the black hood lining, black hardware and multiple sleeve patches make the jacket look generic and logo-led.

candidates.name: Army-Green Puffer
candidates.decisionReason: The black yoke, black hood and dark army-green body create a heavy dated color-block puffer rather than the lighter modern travel palette requested.

candidates.name: Beige Puffer
candidates.decisionReason: The hanging image gives no body proof, and the shiny collapsed beige volume plus dangling hardware is less trustworthy and less colorful than O3.

candidates.name: Coffee Textured Button-Neck Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The fuzzy dropped-shoulder body is too loose beneath a puffer and the coffee color would make the Winter travel look muddy instead of light and clear.

candidates.name: Lavender Corduroy Half-Zip
candidates.decisionReason: Lavender is attractive, but full-resolution review shows a broad dropped shoulder, long bagged sleeves, an oversized body and a bulky chest pocket that would bunch under the puffer.

candidates.name: Sky-Blue Corduroy Quarter-Zip
candidates.decisionReason: It repeats the same dropped, long and bulky corduroy body as T2 and would create a flat blue-on-blue combination with the winning puffer.

candidates.name: Deep-Navy Funnel-Neck Sweatshirt
candidates.decisionReason: The wide dropped sweatshirt body and deep navy would add both excess layer volume and another dark default.

candidates.name: Anchor-Red Heavyweight Tee
candidates.decisionReason: The anchor red is useful, but the wide long short-sleeve tee is not a credible warm Winter layer and would leave the complete outfit dependent on the puffer indoors.

candidates.name: White-Grid Plaid Overshirt
candidates.decisionReason: The boxy twin-pocket overshirt is already an outer layer; placing it under a puffer would stack two bulky layers and the black grid would dominate the pastel palette.

candidates.name: French-Blue Clean Straight Jean
candidates.decisionReason: The narrow worn leg and heavy whiskered wash make the jean look more like dated slim denim than a clean modern travel bottom.

candidates.name: Medium-Blue Straight Jean
candidates.decisionReason: The medium-blue leg visibly stacks and puddles over the shoe, recreating the bottom-heavy silhouette excluded from this rebuild.

candidates.name: Dusty-Blue Straight Jean
candidates.decisionReason: The narrow thigh-to-ankle line reads slim and fitted, and another saturated blue would make the outfit too monochromatic.

candidates.name: Blue-Gray Jean
candidates.decisionReason: The regular upper leg is plausible, but the dark whiskered wash, rolled cuffs and heavy work-boot styling make it more rugged Casual than clean luggage-friendly Travel.

candidates.name: Military-Green Casual Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The isolated wrinkled image lacks rise, seat and full hem proof, while the small multicolor hardware detail looks cheap and distracting.

candidates.name: Pale Sage-Wash Straight Jean
candidates.decisionReason: Full-resolution proof shows a pale sage-wash regular straight leg with controlled ease and one clean break; it brightens the puffer and avoids both skinny taper and baggy stacking. Anchor the pale wash with a darker knit so the Winter Travel palette is not washed out.
